documents.reviewer_notes: Verification in progress. The Parliament-hosted PDF is a candidate source, but its currency and amendment coverage have not been established. PacLII provides a consolidated Constitution marked as at 16 May 2025 and lists Constitutional Amendments Nos. 45, 46 and 47. Compare the Parliament-hosted text with the consolidated version; investigate any later amendments, confirm applicable legal status, and establish redistribution permissions before approval.
